An unputdownable domestic suspense thriller from the bestselling, beloved crime author Emma Curtis
________________

'Emma Curtis is a genius!' ANDREA MARA
'I'm a big fan of Emma Curtis' CLAIRE DOUGLAS
'Page-turning and addictive' JANE CORRY
'Tense and compelling' NAOMI WILLIAMS
'Another knock-out from Emma Curtis' S.E. LYNES
________________

You share a wall. He's keeping a secret...

Mia's best friend Beth warns her not to buy the fixer-upper on Taverner Street. George, the next-door neighbour, seems like a nightmare. He's loud, messy and rude.

But Mia sees the potential and buys the house anyway. Soon, though, George's behaviour strays from erratic to downright threatening. And when Beth goes missing on Taverner Street, Mia fears her friend was right.

This street holds terrible secrets, and uncovering them might be the only way she can find Beth...
___________________

Readers can't get enough of The Neighbour...
''Dark, creepy and compelling'
'Very hard to put down'
'Curtis writes gripping domestic thrillers and The Neighbour is no exception'
'I couldn't guess the many twists'
'I loved it'
